# California B Contractor License Exam Prep

> Independent Chinese-English study website. Not affiliated with CSLB. Verified against official sources on 2026-10-25.

## Current exam baseline
- Official outlines: B 13E-B (03-2026), LAW 13E-LAW (03-2026).
- B approximate weights: Planning & Estimating 15%, Framing & Structural Components 20%, Core Trades 30%, Finish Trades 20%, Safety 15%.
- LAW approximate weights: Business Organization & Licensing 13%, Business Finances 15%, Employment 20%, Insurance & Liens 12%, Contracts 21%, Public Works 5%, Safety 14%.
- Each examination is closed-book, four-option multiple-choice, with 3.5 hours. Do not assert a fixed question count or universal passing percentage from this site.
- B outline lists 2025 California codes. Applicability date on the cover and revision date are distinct.

## Practice bank
- 95 new original bilingual questions: 60 B and 35 LAW, including 40 calculation problems. Each has explanation, source purpose, verification date and difficulty.
- 65 legacy foundation questions remain separate and are not collectively labelled verified-current.
- Practice scores do not establish official exam readiness or passing status.

## Licensing guide
https://cslb.scalintel.com/licensing.html
- Normally four years of qualifying journey-level or higher experience in the prior ten years; part-time is prorated.
- Education/training credits may be granted up to three years, at least one year practical experience, subject to CSLB review.
- Certification form 13A-11 and firsthand certifier; owner-builder adds project-specific 13A-64.
- After acceptance, fingerprint and examination tasks may proceed in parallel after their respective notices.
- Pass exams within 18 months of acceptance/posted; 21 calendar days for retake waiting, two days to cancel/reschedule without forfeiting fee.
- Separate 90-day triggers apply to returned application, receipt of Live Scan packet, and issuance notices.
- Passed exam results can remain valid five years; this does not extend the current application window.
- Application fee $450, initial fee $200 sole owner or $350 other entities. Bond $25,000 is coverage, not automatically a cash cost. Other actual fees/insurance vary.
